02/ 18.08.2023.
Earlier prayer for anticipatory bail filed on behalf of the petitioner has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 22.06.2022 passed in ABA No.2506 of 2022.

Apprehending his arrest, petitioner above-named has renewed his prayer before this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Chakradharpur P.S. Case No.90 of 2019 registered under Sections 420, 406, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Heard the parties.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that after rejection of the anticipatory bail, the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and copy of compromise petition has been filed before the learned court below and the copy thereof has been filed along with the instant application.
As per the terms of the compromise, the petitioner has given a Bank-draft of Rs.8 Lakhs to the informant and for the rest balance amount, post-dated cheques have been issued.
The compromise was entered between the parties on 09.02.2023.
As per the case of prosecution, the petitioner had received a sum of Rs.11,53,000/-.
Learned APP for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer.
It is submitted that the petitioner was CMD of Yadgar Enterprise in which the investments were made by different investors.
Their amount is still outstanding.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel and the fact as discussed above, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.
